You can choose to fail Strength and Dexterity saves. For Wisdom, Intelligence, and Charisma saves, opt for disadvantage instead. Constitution? That's fate's domain.
A natural 20 isn't just luck; it's brilliance. On non-attacks, enjoy a +5 bonus. A natural 1? Brace for a -5 penalty and potential disaster.
Falling in combat is exhausting—literally. Survive death saves, but gain 1 point of exhaustion as the cost.
Magic items speak through their design. Examine them carefully—shape, weight, and feel could reveal their nature before you roll Arcana.
Don't ignore the books! Your reading speed is (1 + INT mod × 2) × 30 pages per hour. Read within 30 days, or your progress vanishes like a forgotten spell.
Phobias can be paralyzing. Fail a Wisdom save, and fear grips you. Succeed, and you act—but with careful concentration.
In Thelemar, reaching level 4 means no hard choices—gain both a feat and an ability score improvement. Power up!
Prayer is more than words. In Thelemar, true devotion requires sacrifice, symbols, and ceremony. Favour grows with effort.
Favour with a god isn't just prestige—it can shape your destiny. Devote yourself, and divine boons await.
Oppose a god, and you'll find their Malice is no idle threat. Earn their ire sparingly—or prepare to face their wrath.
Anxiety isn't just a feeling—it's a mechanic. Miss self-care, and the effects stack. Stay mindful, or watch your rolls suffer.
In Thelemar, knowledge is power—and danger. Some books grant skills; others bite back. Choose your reading wisely.
Critical failures aren't all the same. Roll a natural 1 on an attack? You miss. On a non-attack? That -5 penalty can sting.
In a world of gods, champions are rare. Favour doesn't guarantee the title, but daring deeds might catch divine eyes.
Magic has a logic of its own. Identify items using both your mind and your senses. Arcana checks help—but only if you try.
Sleep is not optional in Thelemar. Miss your rest, and the DC rises with each hour. Even heroes need their beauty sleep—or face exhaustion's embrace.
Swimming in armor? That's a bold choice. Better make those Athletics checks, or the depths will claim you. Each size above Tiny sinks 5 feet deeper per round.
Want to help? Knowledge matters. Without proficiency, your helpful intentions might just make things worse. Master the skill, then lend a hand.
In Thelemar's waters, size matters. Tiny creatures drift like leaves, while giants plummet like stones. Choose your swimming gear wisely.
The gods track both devotion and defiance. Prayers might be answered at +1 per two favor points—but malice brings divine consequences.
Tools and skills work in harmony. Master both, and advantage becomes your friend. In Thelemar, expertise shows in every craft.
Being choked isn't just uncomfortable—it's dangerous for spellcasters. Those verbal components become a gamble when you can't catch your breath.
Hidden doesn't mean invincible. A whisper, a spell, or an attack can reveal your position. Choose your moments of stealth carefully.
Languages aren't binary in Thelemar. Each tongue you know adds wisdom to your Linguistics. Sometimes, understanding comes from unexpected places.
Grappled by a foe? Your options narrow like your throat. Spellcasting becomes a challenge when your hands aren't free.
Restrained isn't just stuck—it's helpless. Forget those somatic components; your magic fails before it begins. Freedom of movement is a spellcaster's friend.
The Dazed mind faces choices: move or act, never both. When your world spins, even simple decisions become tactical challenges.
Divine Champions aren't made by favor alone. Some are chosen with none, while others stack hundreds of prayers without a glance. The gods work in mysterious ways.
Want to break a spellcaster's concentration? A well-timed Disruptive Strike might be just what you need. Sometimes, the best counterspell is a sword.
In Thelemar, knowledge comes in many forms. Lore skills tell tales of expertise, unmarred by natural talent. Pure knowledge, pure proficiency.
Anxiety's grip tightens with neglect. One point brings edge, two points bring chaos, and three? That's when the real troubles begin. Take care of yourself, adventurer.
Divine Votaries know: faith is more than prayer. Spread the word, fight the fights, and show your worth. The gods reward the devoted who act.
Found yourself underwater? Don't panic—unless you're wearing heavy armor. Then maybe panic a little.
The path to becoming an Apostle isn't just about prayer counts. Great deeds, spreading faith, and helping fellow believers—that's what catches divine attention.
When strangling a foe, your grip tells the tale. They might break free with strength or grace, but until then, every breath is a battle.
Think all books are just paper and ink? In Thelemar, some volumes carry Knowledge Hazards. Read with caution—or read with courage.
In the depths of phobia, a friend's steady hand can make all the difference. The Help action might just be the anchor you need to weather the storm.
Divine Malice grows like a shadow: from Disfavor's whisper to Wrath's thunderous roar. Each step darker than the last, each consequence more dire.
Exhaustion in Thelemar isn't just tiredness—it's a creeping decay of ability. Each level subtracts from your rolls AND your spell save DCs. Rest before it's too late.
Combat isn't just about sword and spell. A well-placed strangle can turn the tide. Remember: bonus actions can be just as deadly as actions.
